features.name: cc_has_emphasis_marker
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain an emphasis marker (importantly, crucially, notably, it is worth noting, key point)?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings. If missing or malformed, return null. If the list is empty, return 0. Lowercase each comment and search with regex r'\b(importantly|crucially|notably|it is worth noting|key point)\b'. Return 1 if any comment matches, else 0. Raw literal match with no semantic filtering; matches inside quotations or in any speaker's wording count.

h0: cc_has_emphasis_marker has no association with delta.
h1: Rows whose counter-arguments contain emphasis markers (cc_has_emphasis_marker=1) have a higher probability of delta than rows without them.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the row's delta outcome, so this describes an association and not a causal effect. The marker list is taken literally from the hypothesis and is not exhaustive. A row-level any-comment indicator was chosen because the hypothesis does not specify a count or share. Comments are unordered and have no individual outcomes. Comment text may contain quoted text or post-outcome content, and this raw text is not guaranteed to be outcome-free.
